records.text: Anthony L. Iglesias had been convicted of sexually abusing two Kootenai County brothers and was currently serving time at Idaho State Correctional Institution as of November 2025.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: They hired him anyways—Anthony Iglesias—and he's currently serving time. ... He was found guilty in Idaho State Correctional Facility for his crimes.

verification.notes: The conviction and historical incarceration are supported by 2011 reporting: Iglesias was convicted of sexually abusing two Kootenai County brothers and was then serving time at Idaho State Correctional Institution. The episode’s November 2025 claim that he was still currently serving time was not substantiated by a stable, citable current IDOC record. The transcript also misspeaks that he was “found guilty in” the facility; conviction and incarceration are distinct.

sources.title: Churches protected predator, suit says
sources.relevance: Contemporaneous reporting confirms Iglesias was convicted of sexually abusing two Kootenai County brothers and was serving time at Idaho State Correctional Institution in 2011.

sources.title: Idaho Department of Correction Resident/Client Search
sources.relevance: Official current-status search system consulted; it explains that current custody data changes daily, but no stable individual result was available to substantiate the November 2025 current-incarceration qualifier.
